# NEW 2026-11-18 fourth round D1, the senate's reaction to tribute. Generated by gen_round4_tributary.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# All BYZ scope. The senate's reaction to tribute (gen_round4_tributary.py docstring item 8). BYZ variables:
# oe_ttb_sen_grudge 0..100 the senate's grievance over tribute; oe_ttb_sen_times payments remembered (0..8);
# oe_ttb_sen_tier 0..3; oe_ttb_sen_last points of the last payment (tooltips); oe_ttb_sen_seen the first payment
# was made; oe_ttb_sen_q queued news (0 = first payment, 1..3 = tier entered; expires after 6 months);
# oe_ttb_sen_ev the news being shown.

oe_ttb_sen_init = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_grudge } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_times } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_times value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_tier } } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 0 } }
}
# Contract (oe_ttb_peace_sign, oe_ttb_peace_january): tribute of $amount$ gold has just been paid. Points: 2 for
# each month of total income the payment is worth, times the repeat factor (oe_ttb_sen_repeat), at most 25.
oe_ttb_sen_on_pay = {
    oe_ttb_sen_init = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_last value = $amount$ }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_last divide = oe_ttb_sen_income }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_last multiply = 2 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_last multiply = oe_ttb_sen_repeat }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_last min = 0 max = 25 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge add = var:oe_ttb_sen_last }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge min = 0 max = 100 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_times add = 1 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_times min = 0 max = 8 }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_seen } }
        set_variable = oe_ttb_sen_seen
        random = { chance = 20 set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_q value = 0 months = 6 } }
    }
    oe_ttb_sen_tier_up = yes
}
# Enters every tier the grievance has reached (lowest first).
oe_ttb_sen_tier_up = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_grudge var:oe_ttb_sen_grudge >= 15 var:oe_ttb_sen_tier < 1 } oe_ttb_sen_enter_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_grudge var:oe_ttb_sen_grudge >= 40 var:oe_ttb_sen_tier < 2 } oe_ttb_sen_enter_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_grudge var:oe_ttb_sen_grudge >= 70 var:oe_ttb_sen_tier < 3 } oe_ttb_sen_enter_3 = yes }
}
# Tier 1 entered (grievance >= 15): modifier oe_ttb_sen_mood_1; once: loyalty -3 (chartered cities); news roll.
oe_ttb_sen_enter_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 1 }
    oe_ttb_sen_mood = yes
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_ts_charter = yes } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -3 } }
    oe_ttb_sen_news = { tier = 1 }
}
# Tier 2 entered (grievance >= 40): modifier oe_ttb_sen_mood_2; once: loyalty -3 (seated provinces), authority -2; news roll.
oe_ttb_sen_enter_2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 2 }
    oe_ttb_sen_mood = yes
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -3 } }
    oe_ttb_auth = { amount = -2 }
    oe_ttb_sen_news = { tier = 2 }
}
# Tier 3 entered (grievance >= 70): modifier oe_ttb_sen_mood_3; once: loyalty -5 (seated provinces), authority -3; news roll.
oe_ttb_sen_enter_3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 3 }
    oe_ttb_sen_mood = yes
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes oe_tsn_seated = yes } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -5 } }
    oe_ttb_auth = { amount = -3 }
    oe_ttb_sen_news = { tier = 3 }
}
# A tier was entered: the news is queued with a 30% chance (it replaces any news still waiting).
oe_ttb_sen_news = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_q } remove_variable = oe_ttb_sen_q }
    random = { chance = 30 set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_q value = $tier$ months = 6 } }
}
# The tier's country modifier, and only that one (idempotent; run monthly as well).
oe_ttb_sen_mood = {
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_1 NOT = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 1 } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_2 NOT = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 2 } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_3 NOT = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 3 } } remove_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_3 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 1 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_1 } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_1 years = -1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 2 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_2 } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_2 years = -1 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 3 NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_3 } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ttb_sen_mood_3 years = -1 } }
}
# Monthly from oe_ttb_byz_monthly (before the January payments): the grievance fades by 3% of itself and then by
# 0.25; each January half a remembered payment is forgotten (0.5); tiers are left below their lower bounds.
oe_ttb_sen_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_grudge }
        oe_ttb_sen_init = yes
        change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge multiply = 0.97 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge subtract = 0.25 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge min = 0 max = 100 }
        if = {
            limit = { current_month = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_times subtract = 0.5 }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_times min = 0 max = 8 }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 3 var:oe_ttb_sen_grudge < 40 } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 2 var:oe_ttb_sen_grudge < 15 } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ttb_sen_tier ?= 1 var:oe_ttb_sen_grudge < 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 0 } }
        oe_ttb_sen_mood = yes
    }
}
# From oe_ttb_dispatch when no other event of the track is due this month: the queued news.
oe_ttb_sen_dispatch = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_q } oe_ttb_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb_sen.1 }
}

oe_ttb_sen_test_pay = { oe_ttb_sen_on_pay = { amount = oe_ttb_peace_amount } }
# Grievance +10 and the tier check (news rolls as usual).
oe_ttb_sen_test_add = {
    oe_ttb_sen_init = yes
    change_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge add = 10 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge min = 0 max = 100 }
    oe_ttb_sen_tier_up = yes
}
# The news now, for the current tier (tier 0: the first-payment text).
oe_ttb_sen_test_news = {
    oe_ttb_sen_init = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_q value = var:oe_ttb_sen_tier months = 6 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ttb_sen.1
}
# Grievance, memory, tier, modifier, first-payment flag and queued news cleared. Loyalty and authority already lost stay lost.
oe_ttb_sen_test_reset = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_grudge value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_times value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_sen_tier value = 0 }
    oe_ttb_sen_mood = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_seen } remove_variable = oe_ttb_sen_seen }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_sen_q } remove_variable = oe_ttb_sen_q }
}
